branches.doc: the branches the door merges, in merge order (comma-separated)

door_worktree.doc: the stage-A worktree door<n> (CRLF checkout), branch door_branch

door_branch.doc: the door branch stage A builds and stage B merges

main_checkout.doc: the main checkout stage B installs in

notes_dir.doc: durable folder for the stage NOTES, DOWNTIME.txt, PLAYABLE.txt and the sheet (outside every worktree)

after.doc: after terms the door waits for, e.g. the merged lanes: run:RUN-n:done,run:RUN-m:done

skill.doc: the door procedure skill: FAST DOOR is the default

steps.title: DOOR-{{n}} stage A: merge + C1 + C2 in {{door_worktree}}
DOOR-{{n}} stage B: install in main + C3 boot + C4 sheet
